title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Time, Speed and Distance
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Smriti goes to a shopping mall at a speed of 21 km/hr and returns at a speed of 69 km/hr. Find her average speed (in km/hr) for the entire trip.
questions.explain: For equal distances, the average speed is given by the formula $\frac{2v_1v_2}{v_1 + v_2}$. Plugging in the values: $\frac{2 \times 21 \times 69}{21 + 69} = \frac{2898}{90} = 32.2\text{ km/hr}$.

questions.q: A 325 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 5 km/hr (in the same direction) in 45 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 440 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 20 km/hr?
questions.explain:
Relative speed of train and man (same direction) = Distance / Time = $325\text{ m} / 45\text{ s} = \frac{65}{9}\text{ m/s}$. Convert to km/hr: $\frac{65}{9} \times \frac{18}{5} = 26\text{ km/hr}$. So, Speed of Train - Speed of Man = $26 \Rightarrow$ Speed of Train $- 5 = 26 \Rightarrow$ Speed of Train = 31 km/hr. 
To cross another train in the opposite direction, relative speed = $31 + 20 = 51\text{ km/hr}$. Convert to m/s: $51 \times \frac{5}{18} = \frac{85}{6}\text{ m/s}$. 
Total distance = $325 + 440 = 765\text{ m}$. Time taken = $Distance / Relative Speed = 765 / (85/6) = (765 \times 6) / 85 = 9 \times 6 = 54$ seconds.
